blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A single multimodal large language model (MLLM) struggles to excel simultaneously at detection, localization, description, and reasoning in multimodal industrial anomaly understanding (MM-IAU). We show that in-domain training does not close this gap. On MMAD, a widely adopted MM-IAU benchmark, trained specialists reach at most 75.5% accuracy in defect localization, against 92.3% for human experts, and even detect anomalies less accurately than their untrained base model. Meanwhile, different MLLMs offer complementary strengths but share this weakness in fine-grained perception, so combining them alone cannot remove it. We therefore propose SiGMA, a spatially grounded multi-agent framework that divides labor between heterogeneous MLLM agents and a dedicated visual defect expert. A multimodal searcher supplies industrial knowledge and normal references, the defect expert turns query-reference comparison into calibrated anomaly evidence, and a label-free reliability controller weighs each source by task-wise competence and query-level evidence quality. SiGMA reaches 85.2% average accuracy on MMAD, 4.0% above the strongest trained specialist and Gemini-2.5-Pro and within 1.5% of human experts. Even with three agents of at most 9B parameters, it reaches 84.4%, and new MLLMs join without retraining.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal industrial anomaly understanding (MM-IAU) requires detecting whether a product is defective, localizing the defect, describing its appearance, and reasoning about its potential impact ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Together, these tasks demand a breadth of perceptual and reasoning capabilities that a single multimodal large language model (MLLM) struggles to master ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Defects such as small scratches or missing components often occupy only a small fraction of the image ( Bergmann et al., 2019 ; Zou et al., 2022 ) , so detecting and localizing them requires fine-grained comparison with a normal reference, whereas describing and analyzing them relies on semantic knowledge and reasoning. The prevailing remedy is to specialize a single MLLM through in-domain supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning ( Chao et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Guan et al., 2025 ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . This raises a basic question of whether in-domain training is enough for fine-grained industrial anomaly understanding.
blocks.zh: 多式联运工业异常理解(MM-IAU)要求检测某一产品是否有缺陷,将缺陷本地化,描述其外观,并对其潜在影响的推理(Jiang等,2025年). 这些任务加在一起,需要广泛的认知和推理能力,一个单一的多模式大型语言模型(MLLM)难以掌握(Jiang等,2025;Li等,2025)。 小划痕或缺失组件等缺陷通常只占据图像的一小部分(Bergmann等,2019;Zou等,2022),因此检测和定位需要与正常的参考物进行精细的比较,而描述和分析则依赖于语义知识和推理. 主要的补救措施是通过在域内监督的微调或强化学习专门使用单一的MLLM(Chao等,2025;Zhao等,2025;Guan等,2025;Kang等,2026;Wang等,2026)。 这就提出了一个基本问题,即国内培训是否足以理解精细的工业异常。

blocks.en: Our analysis of 39,670 questions from MMAD ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , a widely adopted MM-IAU benchmark covering seven tasks, suggests that it is not ( Table 1 ). Specialization improves particular capabilities but leaves models uneven across tasks. Although OmniAD ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) and JUDO ( Kang et al., 2026 ) are both trained from Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al., 2025b ) , JUDO outperforms OmniAD by 17.4% in defect description, whereas OmniAD leads in defect classification, localization, and anomaly detection. More importantly, training leaves a pronounced shortfall in fine-grained perception. The strongest trained method for defect localization reaches only 75.5% accuracy, compared with 92.3% for human experts ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , and both OmniAD and JUDO detect anomalies less accurately than their untrained base model (68.8% and 65.0% vs. 70.5%). In-domain training thus leaves a substantial gap in the capability most central to industrial inspection.
blocks.zh: 我们对MMAD(Jiang等,2025年)的39,670个问题的分析表明,它不是(表1)。 专业化可以提高特定的能力,但模式在任务之间不平衡。 虽然OmniAD(赵等,2025年)和JUDO(Kang等,2026年)都是从Quen2.5-VL-7B(Bai等,2025年b)接受训练的,但JUDO在缺陷描述上比OmniAD的成绩高出了17.4%,而OmniAD则导致缺陷分类,本地化和异常检测. 更为重要的是,培训使精细感知明显不足。 接受过培训的缺陷本地化最强方法的准确度仅为75.5%,而人类专家的准确度为92.3%(Jiang等人,2025年),OmniAD和JUDO检测异常的准确度都低于未经培训的基准模型(68.8%和65.0%对70.5%)。 因此,国内培训在工业检查能力方面留下了巨大的差距。

blocks.en: Different MLLMs nevertheless offer complementary strengths, which multi-model methods can combine ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Ong et al., 2025 ) . Among the ten compact MLLMs in Table 1 , Qwen3-VL-4B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) performs best on anomaly detection and defect localization, whereas GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking ( Hong et al., 2025 ) leads defect description, defect analysis, and object classification while ranking only eighth of ten in anomaly detection. This complementarity, however, does not extend to fine-grained perception, where the weakness is shared across models. Defect localization averages only 55.94% across the ten models, and even selecting the best model for each task leaves detection and localization at 74.1% and 63.6%. Nor does scale remove this weakness. Within the Qwen3-VL family, the 8B model localizes defects less accurately than the 4B model (60.8% vs. 63.6%), and even Gemini-2.5-Pro ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) reaches only 67.2% in defect localization. Because combining predictions can only recover errors on which models disagree ( Krogh and Vedelsby, 1994 ) , composing MLLMs alone cannot close this gap.
blocks.zh: 然而,不同的MLLMs提供了互补优势,这些多模式方法可以结合(Jiang等,2023;Wang等,2025;Ong等,2025)。 在表1的10个紧凑的MLLMs中,Qune3-VL-4B(Bai等,2025年a)在异常探测和缺陷本地化方面表现最出色,而GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking(Hong等,2025年)则导致缺陷描述,缺陷分析和对象分类,而在异常探测中仅排在十分之八. 然而,这种互补性并没有延伸到精细的观念,因为这种观念的弱点在各种模式中都存在。 10种模式的本地化平均只有55.94%,甚至为每项任务选择最佳模式,检测和本地化率分别为74.1%和63.6%。 尺度也不能消除这一弱点。 在Qune3-VL家族内部,8B模型的缺陷本地化比4B模型(60.8%对63.6%)差,甚至双子座-2.5-Pro(Comanici等人,2025年)在缺陷本地化中也只有67.2%. 因为结合预测只能取回模型有分歧的错误(克罗克和维德尔斯比,1994年),单是编组MLLM是无法弥补这一差距的.

blocks.en:
We therefore pursue a division of labor that brings heterogeneous MLLM agents and a dedicated visual defect expert into the same framework. The agents contribute complementary judgments across inspection tasks, while the defect expert supplies localized defect evidence through explicit comparison with normal references ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , a source that does not rely on MLLM perception.
This evidence must be used with care, since naively overlaying anomaly maps on MLLM inputs lowers anomaly-detection accuracy by up to 12.62%, partly because detectors respond spuriously on normal images ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . The expert’s evidence therefore needs calibration, and its influence should depend on the task and on the evidence quality of each query.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们实行分工,将各种 MLLM 代理人和一个专门的视觉缺陷专家纳入同一框架。 这些代理人在视察任务中作出补充性判断,而缺陷专家通过与正常参考文献的明确比较提供局部缺陷证据(Zhang等,2026年),这一来源不依赖于MLLM感知.
这些证据必须谨慎使用,因为天真地将MLLM输入的异常图叠加起来,使异常-检测精度降低至12.62%,部分原因是探测器在正常图像上做出虚假反应(Jiang等人,2025年)。 因此,专家的证据需要校准,其影响应取决于每项查询的任务和证据质量。

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce SiGMA, a spatially grounded multi-agent framework following a search–reason–ground–aggregate workflow. A multimodal searcher retrieves industrial knowledge and a normal reference as shared context, and heterogeneous MLLM agents answer independently. In parallel, a defect expert calibrates query–reference discrepancies against normal statistics and converts them into answers through expert reader agents. A label-free reliability controller then weighs each source by task-wise competence and query-level evidence quality. Figure 1 illustrates the resulting fine-grained defect localization. All model parameters remain frozen, so new MLLMs can join the team without retraining.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了SiGMA,这是一个基于空间的多代理框架,遵循搜索-合理-地面-综合工作流程。 多式联运搜索器检索工业知识和通常的参考材料,作为共同的上下文,各种多语言的MLLM代理独立回答。 同时,一位缺陷专家校正查询 - 参照正常统计数据的差异,并通过专家读者代理将其转化为答案. 一个无标签的可靠性控制器然后根据任务权限和查询级证据质量来权衡每个源. 图1说明了由此产生的精细缺陷本地化情况。 所有模型参数仍然被冻结,因此新的MLLM可以加入团队而无需再培训.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. (i) We show that in-domain training is not enough for fine-grained industrial anomaly understanding, since trained MLLMs remain uneven across tasks and share a perceptual weakness, which motivates a division of labor between complementary MLLMs and a visual defect expert. (ii) We introduce SiGMA, which combines heterogeneous MLLM predictions with calibrated reference-based defect evidence through a label-free reliability controller that accounts for task-wise source competence and query-specific evidence quality. (iii) On MMAD, SiGMA reaches 85.2% average accuracy, 4.0% above both JUDO and Gemini-2.5-Pro, with its largest gains over trained methods in anomaly detection ( 13.8 % ↑ 13.8\%\uparrow ) and defect localization ( 4.1 % ↑ 4.1\%\uparrow ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献如下。 (一)我们表明,国内培训不足以理解精细的工业异常现象,因为经过培训的MLLM在各项任务之间仍然不平衡,并有着共同的认知弱点,这促使互补的MLLM和视觉缺陷专家分工。 (二)我们引入了SiGMA,它通过一个无标签的可靠性控制器,将不同的MLLM预测和有校准的基于参考的缺陷证据结合起来,该控制器考虑到任务源能力和特定查询证据的质量. (三) 在MMAD上,SiGMA达到了85.2%的平均精度,比JUDO和双子座-2.5-Pro都高出4.0%,比在异常探测(13.8%-13.8-uparrow)和缺陷局部化(4.1%-4.1-uparrow)方面训练有素的方法收益最大。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: MLLM-based methods for MM-IAU ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) mostly specialize a single model through supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning ( Chao et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Guan et al., 2025 ; Kang et al., 2026 ) , learned comparison with normal templates ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , internal expert modules ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , or trained tool use ( Miao et al., 2025 ) . Others keep one MLLM frozen and guide it with retrieved knowledge and normal images ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , a design our searcher adopts, or with test-time latent optimization ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . In both cases one model carries every capability, so the system’s perception rests on that model. SiGMA instead divides these capabilities among heterogeneous frozen MLLMs and a reference-based visual defect expert.
blocks.zh: MM-IAU基于MLLM的方法(Jiang等,2025年)大多通过有监督的微调或强化学习(Chao等,2025年;Zhao等,2025年;Guan等,2025年;Kang等,2026年),与普通模板(Jiang等,2026年),内部专家模块(Wang等,2026年),或经过培训的工具使用(Miao等,2025年)来专门使用单一模型. 其他人则保留一个MLLM并用检索到的知识和正常图像指导它(Jiang等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年),这是我们搜索者采用的设计,或试验时间潜在优化(Chen等人,2026年)。 在这两种情况下,一个模型都具有各种能力,因此系统的认识就建立在这个模型之上。 反之,SiGMA将这些能力分成了多种被冻结的MLLMs和一个基于参考的视觉缺陷专家.

blocks.en: Combining models helps when their errors differ ( Krogh and Vedelsby, 1994 ) . Existing methods rank and fuse responses ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) , route queries ( Ong et al., 2025 ) , or synthesize outputs with an aggregator model ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Ranking and routing learn their selectors from labeled or preference data, which industrial settings rarely provide, while aggregator-based synthesis adds model calls and relies on a single aggregator to judge which responses to trust. More fundamentally, these methods cannot fix a weakness shared by the whole pool. Label-free reliability estimation ( Dawid and Skene, 1979 ; Whitehill et al., 2009 ) removes the need for labels but typically assigns each source one competence across all items and uses no evidence beyond the votes. Our SiGMA extends this estimation with task-wise competence and admits an external visual expert, weighted by query-level evidence quality.
blocks.zh: 组合模型在错误不同时有所帮助(克罗克和维德尔斯比,1994.). 现有方法排序和引信反应(Jiang等人,2023年),路线查询(Ong等人,2025年),或用聚合模型合成输出(Wang等人,2025年)。 排名和路由从标签或偏好数据中学习其选择者,工业环境很少提供这些数据,而基于聚合的合成则会增加模型调用,并依靠单一聚合器来判断对信任的反应。 更根本的是,这些方法无法纠正整个集合所共有的弱点。 无标签可靠性估计(Dawid和Skene,1979年;Whitehill等人,2009年)取消了对标签的需要,但通常赋予每个来源一个权限,涵盖所有项目,而且没有使用超出投票范围的证据。 我们的SiGMA将这一估计扩展为任务胜任能力,并接纳一名外部视觉专家,按查询级证据质量加权。

blocks.en: Other methods feed vision-expert evidence to a single MLLM, either by training it to consume anomaly maps or expert tokens ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) or without training through map overlays ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) and confidence-gated attention guidance ( Peng et al., 2026 ) . Trained variants tie the evidence to one model, overlays can mislead the MLLM with spurious responses on normal images, and attention guidance requires access to the MLLM’s internal attention. Our SiGMA instead calibrates reference-based evidence ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) against normal residual statistics, lets several MLLM readers interpret it, and weighs their answers by label-free reliability and evidence quality.
blocks.zh: 其他方法为单一的MLLM提供视觉专家证据,方法有的是通过培训其消耗异常地图或专家信使(Gu等,2024;Li等,2023;Li等,2025;Xu等,2025;),有的则通过地图叠加(Jiang等,2025)和信心关注指导(Peng等,2026.)不进行培训. 训练的变体将证据绑在一个模型上,叠接会用在正常图像上的虚假反应来误导MLLM,而注意力引导需要获得MLLM的内部关注. 我们的"SiGMA"取而代之,将基于参考的证据(Zhang等,2026年)与正常的剩余统计校正,让多位MLLM读取者解读,并以无标签的可靠性和证据质量来权衡他们的答案.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation and Motivation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出和动机

blocks.en: Each MM-IAU instance consists of a query image, an inspection question, and a set of candidate answers. Section 1 identified three properties of this task. Capabilities are distributed across MLLMs, fine-grained perception is a weakness they share, and the value of expert evidence varies across tasks and queries. SiGMA therefore divides labor among three roles within a search–reason–ground–aggregate workflow ( Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 每个MM-IAU实例包括一个查询图像,一个检查问题,以及一组候选答案. 第一节确定了这项任务的三个属性。 能力分布在MLLMs之间,精细的感知是他们共同的弱点,专家证据的价值因任务和查询而异. 因此,SiGMA在搜索-合理-地面-汇总工作流程中将劳动分为三个角色(图2)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Multimodal Searcher
blocks.zh: 3.2 多式联运搜索器

blocks.en: Judging whether a product is defective requires knowing what it should look like, which general-purpose MLLMs cannot infer from the query image alone. Following prior work that guides MLLMs with retrieved domain knowledge and normal images ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , we construct query-specific context by multimodal retrieval. For the i i -th MM-IAU instance, let I i I_{i} denote the query image and q i q_{i} the complete multiple-choice prompt, including the question and candidate-answer contents. The searcher encodes I i I_{i} with a frozen CLIP model ( Radford et al., 2021 ) . Its text branch retrieves industrial knowledge d i d_{i} , including product semantics, normal structures, and defect-related descriptions, and its visual branch selects the most similar normal reference r i r_{i} from a category-specific gallery. The knowledge d i d_{i} grounds the heterogeneous agents semantically, whereas r i r_{i} anchors normal appearance for both the agents and the defect expert. The sources of the textual knowledge and normal references are specified in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 3.4 Fine-Grained Defect Expert
blocks.zh: 3.4 精致缺陷专家

blocks.en: Composing heterogeneous agents cannot recover perceptual errors that all of them share. Small scratches, missing components, and subtle structural deformations may occupy only a limited portion of the image and can be overlooked during holistic visual reasoning by every agent. We therefore introduce a fine-grained defect expert that localizes query–reference discrepancies without relying on MLLM perception, calibrates the resulting evidence to suppress unreliable responses, and passes the calibrated map to expert readers agents, that we call readers for short. The readers need not find a subtle defect themselves, since they only interpret explicitly highlighted evidence and map it to an answer option.
blocks.zh: 构成各种物剂无法恢复所有物剂共有的感知错误。 小的划痕,缺失的组件,和微妙的结构变形可能只占据了图像的有限部分,在整体视觉推理过程中,每个代理人都可以被忽略. 因此,我们引入了一位精细的缺陷专家,该专家在不依赖MLLM感知的情况下将查询-参考差异本地化,校正由此产生的证据以压制不可靠的反应,并将校正的地图传递给专家读者代理人,我们称读者为简写. 读者不需要自己找到一个微妙的缺陷,因为他们只解释明确突出的证据,并将其映射到一个答案选项上.

blocks.en: The preceding modules provide complementary answer predictions, but their contributions depend on both the question type and the spatial evidence available for a query. The reliability controller accounts for these two factors by estimating global and task-wise source competence and modulating reader influence using spatial evidence. It operates on the predictions of frozen models; only the controller’s aggregation statistics are estimated. The controller estimates these statistics from the unlabeled predictions of a batch of test queries, which in our experiments is the full MMAD evaluation set, so it operates transductively (Appendix B ).

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 实验和分析

blocks.en: Our experiments test the argument of Section 1 in turn. Section 4.2 asks whether in-domain training is enough by comparing SiGMA with trained specialists and large-scale MLLMs. Section 4.3 isolates what composition and the defect expert each contribute and tests whether composing MLLMs alone can close the perception gap. Section 4.4 examines how expert evidence should be calibrated and weighted, and Section 4.5 reports the trade-off between accuracy and cost.

blocks.en: We evaluate on MMAD ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) (39,670 multiple-choice questions across seven types), reporting accuracy per type and the unweighted mean; stated gains and losses are absolute differences, denoted by %. Appendix A enumerates the ten candidate MLLMs and identifies the eight base agents and three expert readers in the main configuration. It also specifies the constituent datasets, baselines, one-shot protocol, and hyperparameters. The team and hyperparameters were selected on MMAD answers, so we also report the full ten-agent pool without subset selection. For a fixed configuration, the controller uses no labels and is fit transductively on the unlabeled evaluation predictions (Appendix B ). Each MLLM receives one retrieved normal reference, while the expert uses a category-specific bank of at most 256 images.

blocks.en: 4.2 Is In-Domain Training Enough?
blocks.zh: 4.2 国内培训是否足够?

blocks.en: Table 1 compares SiGMA with trained specialists. SiGMA improves most on the two perception-centric tasks, raising anomaly detection by 13.8% ↑ \uparrow and defect localization by 4.1% ↑ \uparrow over the best training-based methods. The contrast is sharpest in anomaly detection, where all four training-based methods ( 60.6–68.8% ) fall below the frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( 70.5% ), the base model of OmniAD and JUDO, whereas SiGMA reaches 82.6% . On the other five tasks SiGMA ranges from 3.0% ↓ \downarrow below to 1.3% ↑ \uparrow above the best training-based method, and on average it exceeds the strongest one, JUDO, by 4.0% ↑ \uparrow . SiGMA trails JUDO only in defect description ( 1.4% ↓ \downarrow ) and defect analysis ( 3.0% ↓ \downarrow ), the two tasks that rely most on domain-specific expression and reasoning. These results suggest that in-domain training mainly improves domain-specific language, while perceptual limitations persist.
blocks.zh: 表1将SiGMA与经过培训的专家进行比较。 SiGMA在两个以感知为中心的任务上改善最多, 反差在异常探测中最为尖锐,所有四种以训练为基础的方法(60.6–68.8 %)都低于被冻结的Quen2.5-VL-7B(70.5%),OmniAD和JUDO的基础模型,而SiGMA则达到82.6%. 在其他五项任务上,SiGMA从3.0%~下行到1.3%~上行到最佳训练方法,平均比最强的JUDO高出4.0%~上行。 SiGMA追蹤JUDO只在缺陷描述(1.4% QQ\下owarrow)和缺陷分析(3.0% QQ\下owarrow)中进行,这两个任务最依赖域特有表达和推理. 这些结果表明,域内培训主要改进特定领域语言,而观念限制仍然存在。

blocks.en: Among large-scale MLLMs, the best defect-localization accuracy is 69.1% (GPT-5-mini), 10.5% ↓ \downarrow below SiGMA. In anomaly detection, SiGMA comes within 0.8% of Gemini-2.5-Flash and 0.5% of Gemini-2.5-Pro while using open models of at most 9B parameters, and all three remain at least 11.8% ↓ \downarrow below human experts ( 95.2% ). SiGMA exceeds Gemini-2.5-Pro by 4.0% ↑ \uparrow on average and achieves the best result among all methods on four of the seven tasks. Relative to human experts, it is 1.5% ↓ \downarrow lower on average and higher on defect classification, object classification, and object analysis. The largest remaining gaps are anomaly detection ( 12.6% ↓ \downarrow ) and defect localization ( 12.7% ↓ \downarrow ), the capabilities that Section 1 identified as the shared weakness of MLLMs.

blocks.en: We test each alternative explanation in turn. First, the full ten-agent pool ( Figure 3 (a) ), which involves no subset selection, reaches 84.9% , which is 3.7% ↑ \uparrow above JUDO and Gemini-2.5-Pro. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和限制

blocks.en: This work asked whether in-domain training is enough for fine-grained industrial anomaly understanding, and our results on MMAD suggest that it is not. Trained specialists trail human experts most in anomaly detection and defect localization, a perceptual weakness that different MLLMs share and that composing them does not remove. SiGMA therefore pairs heterogeneous frozen MLLM agents, which improve the semantic tasks, with a defect expert whose calibrated evidence improves detection and localization, and weighs each source by task and query without labels. It reaches 85.2% average accuracy, 4.0% above the strongest trained specialist and Gemini-2.5-Pro, and 84.4% with three agents of at most 9B parameters.
blocks.zh: 这项工作问道,国内培训是否足以对工业异常情况进行精细了解,我们关于MMAD的结果表明情况并非如此。 训练有素的专家跟踪人类专家在异常探测和缺陷局部化方面最为突出,这种认知弱点不同 MLLM 共享,而组成它们并不能消除。 因此,SiGMA配对了异质被冻结的MLLM剂,这改善了语义任务,与一位缺陷专家配对,他校准的证据能改善检测和本地化,并且通过任务和查询来权衡每个来源,没有标签. 平均精度达到85.2%,高于最强的训练有素的专家和双子座-2.5-Pro,84.4%具有最多为9B参数的三种剂.

blocks.en: Several limitations remain. Although our experiments use only MMAD, the benchmark spans four source datasets and seven tasks, offering some evidence of generalization across industrial settings. SiGMA requires no model training, and its source-reliability parameters can be estimated automatically from unlabeled predictions on new data. Our controller estimates source reliability from the unlabeled evaluation batch, making the full result transductive. Even without batch-level statistics, majority voting over the same sources reaches 83.3% ( Table 2 , row d), exceeding every baseline in Table 1 . Aggregation cannot correct errors that every source shares, which SiGMA mitigates with a defect expert independent of MLLM perception, and without it defect localization drops by 13.8% ( Table 2 ). SiGMA still trails human experts by 12.6% in anomaly detection and 12.7% in defect localization, though by less than any trained method. Finally, several MLLMs add inference cost, but a three-agent team retains 84.4% at 1.5 s per question, against 1.2 s for JUDO, and new MLLMs can join the team without retraining the existing models.
blocks.zh: 仍然存在若干限制。 虽然我们的实验只使用MMAD,但基准跨越了4个源数据集和7个任务,提供了跨工业环境的一般化的一些证据。 SiGMA不需要模型训练,其源可靠性参数可以从新数据的无标签预测中自动估计出. 我们的管制员估计来源的可靠性 从没有标签的评价批量, 使完全结果转录。 即使没有分批统计,多数对同一来源的投票也达到83.3%(表2, 第d行),超过了表1的每个基准。 聚合无法校正每个源共享的错误,SiGMA通过独立于MLLM感知的缺陷专家来缓解这些错误,如果没有它会使本地化下降13.8%(表2). SiGMA仍然以12.6%的异常探测率和12.7%的缺陷本地化率跟踪人类专家,尽管这些技术比任何经过训练的方法都少. 最后,几个MLLMs增加了推论成本,但一个三代理团队保留84.4%,每问题1.5 s,而JUDO则保留了1.2 s,新的MLLMs可以加入团队而无需再培训现有的模型.

blocks.en: The text branch of the multimodal searcher uses the domain knowledge provided with MMAD ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) as its knowledge database. This resource supplies the product semantics, normal-structure descriptions, and defect-related descriptions used to construct the retrieved context d i d_{i} . It is separate from the normal-image reference gallery described below and does not include evaluation answers.

blocks.en: For each product category, we construct the reference gallery from normal images in the training partition of its source dataset. MMAD draws its one-shot normal templates from these same underlying image pools ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Our gallery is assembled from the category-level pool rather than restricted to MMAD’s query-specific template lists, and contains at most 256 images per category. Evaluation query images are excluded from the gallery. Each MLLM receives one retrieved normal reference. At K = 1 K=1 , that image also constitutes the spatial expert’s entire normal bank, and Noise-Robust Calibration is skipped. For K > 1 K>1 , the expert uses the larger bank for calibration while each MLLM still receives one reference.
blocks.zh: 对于每个产品类别,我们从其源数据集的训练分区中从正常图像中构建出参考画廊. MMAD从这些相同的基本图像池中抽取出一发普通模板(Jiang等,2025年)。 我们的画廊从分类级别集合起来,而不是局限于MMAD的查询特定模板列表,每个类别包含最多256个图像。 评价查询图像被排除在画廊之外。 每个MLLM都收到一个检索到的正常参考. 在 K = 1 K = 1 时, 该图像也构成空间专家的整个正常库, 而噪声- Robust校正被跳过 。 用于 K > 1K>1,专家使用较大的库来校正,而每个MLLM仍然收到一个参考.

blocks.en: To study the accuracy–cost trade-off, we evaluated candidate subsets of the ten base MLLMs on MMAD and report the highest-accuracy subset for each team size in Figure 3 (a) . The MMAD evaluation answers were used to compare these subsets, including the eight-agent team yielding 85.2% in Table 1 . This benchmark-level choice of team is separate from the reliability controller: once a team is fixed, its source statistics and per-question predictions are computed without answer labels. The agent-count curve describes the evaluated combinations rather than an automatic team-selection procedure for unseen data. The archived SiGMA averages for k = 8 , 9 , 10 k{=}8,9,10 are 85.2% , 85.1% , and 84.9% , respectively. Relative to the eight-agent team, k = 9 k{=}9 adds InternVL3-8B and k = 10 k{=}10 also includes Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking.
blocks.zh: 为了研究准确性-成本权衡,我们在MMAD上评价了10个基础MLLM的候选子集,并在图3(a)中报告每个团队规模的最高精确子集。 MMAD的评价答案被用来比较这些子集,包括表1中8个代理团队的85.2%。 这种基准级别的团队选择与可靠性控制器是分开的:一旦一个团队固定下来,其源统计数据和每问题预测都会在没有答案标签的情况下被计算出. 代理计数曲线描述的是被评价的组合,而不是对未见数据的自动团队选择程序. 存档的SiGMA平均值为:k=8;9;10 k{=}8;9;10分别为:85.2%;85.1%;84.9%. 相较于八能特攻队,k=9 k{=}9又增加了InternVL3-8B和k=10 k{=}10也包含了Qune3-VL-4B-Thinking.

blocks.en: We selected the reported hyperparameters by comparing candidate settings using the MMAD evaluation answers, following the same benchmark-level selection protocol as the agent subsets above. This includes the noise-robust calibration and spatial-coherence gate settings, together with the reliability controller settings listed in Appendix A . Once selected, these values are fixed for all reported questions; answer labels are not used when estimating source reliability or aggregating predictions for a fixed configuration. Thus, the reported accuracy reflects configuration choices made on MMAD and should not be interpreted as performance under label-free hyperparameter selection on an unseen benchmark.
blocks.zh: 我们通过使用MMAD评价答案比较候选人设置,选择了所报告的超参数,采用了与上文代理子集相同的基准级选择协议。 这包括噪声-扰动校正和空间-一致性门设置,以及附录A所列出的可靠性控制器设置. 一旦选定,这些数值将固定在所有报告的问题上;在估计源可靠性或汇总对固定配置的预测时,不使用答案标签. 因此,报告的准确性反映了在MMAD上作出的配置选择,不应被解释为在无标签的超参数选择下在看不见的基准上的性能。

blocks.en: The empirical CDF used to normalize spatial-evidence statistics and the global and task-wise source-reliability estimates are computed from the unlabeled predictions and valid spatial statistics of the MMAD evaluation questions. We use no separate query calibration split. blocks.en: Table 6 (a) shows why a localization signal cannot simply be overlaid on the base-agent inputs. Relative to no expert, the raw overlay raises defect-localization accuracy from 65.8% to 75.0%, but lowers anomaly-detection accuracy from 75.1% to 69.8% and raises the false-positive rate on normal images from 17.8% to 30.6%. Passing the raw map through expert readers instead improves detection to 73.5% and reduces false positives to 24.2%. Routing limits the harm, yet raw evidence still performs worse than no expert on these two detection measures.
blocks.zh: 表6(a)显示为何不能简单地将本地化信号覆盖在基剂投入上。 与没有专家相比,原始覆盖将缺陷定位精度从65.8%提升至75.0%,但异常检测精度从75.1%降低至69.8%,并将正常图像上的假阳性率从17.8%提升至30.6%. 将原始地图通过专家阅读器将检测率提高到73.5%,并将假阳性降低到24.2%。 运行限制伤害,然而原始证据的表现仍然比没有专家对这两种检测措施进行鉴定还差.

blocks.en: Calibrating the reader map raises detection by 7.4% and localization by 2.8% relative to the raw-reader row, while reducing the false-positive rate by 11.4%. The spatial-coherence gate then raises detection from 80.9% to 82.6% and reduces false positives from 12.8% to 9.4%; localization remains at 79.6%. This pattern matches the task-dependent design in Section 3.5 : the gate controls reader admission for anomaly detection, while localization can use the calibrated overlay without that test. Relative to no expert, the complete route gains 7.5% in detection and 13.8% in localization, and reduces the false-positive rate by 8.4%.
blocks.zh: 校正读取图比生读取行提高检测率7.4%,本地化率2.8%,同时将假阳性率降低11.4%. 然后空间协调门将检测率从80.9%提高到82.6%,并将假阳性从12.8%降低到9.4%;局部化仍为79.6%. 这种模式与3.5节中的任务依赖性设计相匹配:门控制阅读器录入进行异常检测,而本地化无需经过该测试即可使用被校正的叠放. 与没有专家相比,完整路线在检测中收益7.5%,在本地化中收益13.8%,将假阳性率降低8.4%。

blocks.en: Table 6 (b) fixes the prediction sources and varies only aggregation. Global Dawid–Skene estimation raises average accuracy from 83.3% under majority vote to 84.0%, and task-wise competence raises it to 84.8%. Query-level evidence weighting brings the average to 85.2%, with a 1.7% detection gain over task-wise competence. The two table parts therefore test distinct choices; their intermediate rows should be compared within each part. These gains are measured on MMAD with a team and hyperparameters selected using MMAD answers (Appendix B ), rather than on a held-out benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表6(b) 确定预测来源,只进行汇总。 Global Dawid–Skene估计将平均精度从83.3%的多数选票提高到84.0%,而任务能力则提高到84.8%。 查询级证据权重平均为85.2%,检测率高于任务能力1.7%. 因此,两个表格部分测试了不同的选择;其中间行应在每一部分内进行比较。 这些增益在MMAD上用使用MMAD答案(附录B)选择的团队和超参数来计量,而不是用被搁置的基准来计量.
